grade_reason: No statement by Tom Sell about AI of any kind was found from 1 January 2025 onward; his campaign coverage is about agriculture, the farm bill and federal spending.
notes: 8 web searches ran, none refused. No campaign site was found: tomsellforcongress.com and tomsell.com are parked domains for sale, and the search for a campaign issues page returned nothing; Ballotpedia's page came back empty when fetched and notes (per search snippet) that he did not complete its candidate survey. The only AI link found is money, not words: Texas Tribune (1 April 2026, https://www.texastribune.org/2026/04/01/texas-congress-ai-super-pacs-artificial-intelligence-regulation-2026-midterms/) reports the AI-industry-linked super PAC American Mission (Leading the Future network, which favors a lighter regulatory touch) spent about $579,000 for him in the runoff; the article quotes no AI position from Sell. That is not a statement by him and does not affect the grade. A Lubbock Lights profile (https://lubbocklights.com/sell-hopes-experience-working-with-combest-in-congress-emphasizing-work-on-farm-bill-will-sell-him-to-voters/) has no AI remarks. As a non-member he could not have sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, and he did not sign the House letters. Search coverage of his campaign Facebook page, debates and local radio interviews was not possible, so an AI remark there could have been missed.
